subject: general
question: In plants, diffusion is mainly responsible for the process of transportation. However for transport of some substances, energy is needed. Which option shows the substances transported using energy from ATP?
solution:
The correct answer is **Food, amino acids and hormones.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Transportation **is an important phenomenon which helps in** transfer of particles **which will **take place in all organisms including plants.**
 
• The process of transportation takes place mainly through **diffusion **process in plants.
 
• In transportation of plants, main substances that transports include **food, water, gases, organic matter like amino acids and hormones.**
 
• The process of diffusion **doesn't require more energy.**

Thus, from the given options Food, amino acids and hormones is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Movement of particles from the region of higher concentration to the lower one is called as diffusion.**
 
• **Different substances** that transport like Food, amino acids and hormones **diffuse at the same time** at ATP.
 
• This process happens because as the** partial pressure is higher in higher concentration region** than in lower, it moves from **high-low region.**
